name: Tiny Terrors
summary: Tiny Terrors is an immersive locomotion based horror game where you play as a small primate navigating a dark, eerie environment. Evade monstrous creatures, solve spine-chilling puzzles, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten world. Every move counts as you run, climb, and swing through terrifying landscapes. Can you outsmart the horrors lurking in the shadows and escape the nightmare?
